name: no-words-oromo
why: The path that matters most for the long tail. Chirp returns empty word arrays for exactly the languages this product exists to serve, so hasWords=false is a main path and not an edge case. Every segment falls back to interval overlap and EVERY segment is flagged — including s0, which sits wholly inside one speaker's turn at purity 1.0. Without words we cannot see a mid-segment speaker change at all, so a high interval overlap is evidence about the segment's SPAN, not about who spoke each part of it.
